title: Quit working after 3 uses!! DO NOT PURCHASE!
text: Quit working after 3 uses!! DO NOT PURCHASE!. I spent $130 on this and when it stopped functioning (the floor attachment, not the hand-held piece) I asked for assistance directly from Bissell. I was told to clean out the brush, which wasn't full - I live alone, with mostly tile, and have no pets.  It still does not work - buy a Dyson instead!
